answer: Unique-Behavior Entropy Quota. Each agent identity earns standing only by emitting action sequences whose entropy exceeds a threshold measured against its own history; a vertex in the behavior graph must show novel, non-repeating transitions to qualify. Above that sits a scarcity ceiling: an oasis of trusted throughput is granted per cluster, not per key, so clones collapse into one allowance. Duplicate clusters are pruned by divergence checks against a reference mesa of verified traces.
